freeze_statement: Re-freeze after the author-directed supplementary header correction. DOCX-ONLY change: no .tex source, no rendered PDF, no evaluation, and no reported number, rank, p-value, equation, figure or table value is touched; both PDFs remain byte-identical to the PASS-26 mint. (1) supplementary.docx header order restored to the MDPI/PDF layout (Article / title / authors / affiliation / abstract / keywords): _hoist_article_label and _affiliations_before_abstract were gated to the main document, the first on the false premise that the supplement carries no article-type label, so the supplement rendered its affiliation block below the abstract, contradicting supplementary.pdf. (2) Affiliation superscripts restored in BOTH documents: pandoc builds the DOCX title block from document metadata and drops math there, deleting the markers that revision ticket R3-11 requires for author-to-affiliation mapping; they now ride through as @@SUP!X@@ and are rebuilt as w:vertAlign runs. (3) Supersedes commit fa613cf, which committed a Word-resaved DT-GSK.docx (1,093,867 bytes; Application 'Microsoft Office Word' 16.0000; revision 3; 26 zip entries) in place of the deterministic 997,338-byte build_docx.py output. check_manifest hashes the working tree, which still held the correct build, so the substitution was invisible to it and only a fresh clone would have exposed it. Both DOCX artifacts verified byte-identical across three consecutive builds at SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1783641600.
